mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate at or below 0.1% (FEDFUNDS) indicates ultra-accommodative monetary policy that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS ≤ 0.1% (t-test p > 0.05 vs positive return expectation).

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1500.0 (HOUST) signals weakening consumer demand, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when HOUST < 1500.0 (t-test p > 0.05 vs negative return expectation).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in manufacturing output (INDPRO) and employment growth (PAYEMS) below 3-month averages indicate labor market deterioration, producing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when INDPRO and PAYEMS both decline (t-test p > 0.05 vs negative return expectation).

mechanism_narrative: In a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS > 1.0%), rising interest rates compress equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 1.0% (t-test p > 0.05 vs negative return expectation).

mechanism_narrative: Strong GDP growth (GDPC1 > 2.0% annualized) indicates robust economic expansion, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in > 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth exceeds 2.0% (t-test p > 0.05 vs positive return expectation).

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 7.0% (UNRATE) signals labor market stress, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in > 60% of instances when UNRATE > 7.0% (t-test p > 0.05 vs negative return expectation).

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in housing starts (HOUST < 1500.0) and residential sales (RSAFS < 500000.0) indicate housing sector collapse, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when HOUST < 1500.0 and RSAFS < 500000.0 (t-test p > 0.05 vs negative return expectation).

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 95.0 (INDPRO) signals supply chain disruption, triggering negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in > 60% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0 (t-test p > 0.05 vs negative return expectation).
